_what: The expectation for the 2026-10-09 full gate, written and COMMITTED BEFORE the run so the result cannot be read backwards into it.
_why_a_separate_file: kaggle/eval_gate_production_2026_10_09.py's summary payload names this path as its pre-registration. For five weeks CLAUDE.md taught a 3.5% presumptive figure its own engine had already corrected, and the lesson recorded was that a claim whose evidence is one lookup away must actually BE one lookup away. The summary made the claim before this file existed; that is now closed.
_committed_before_the_run: The run has NOT happened. If a results artifact for 2026-10-09 exists alongside this file, this file predates it in git history and that is checkable with `git log --diff-filter=A`.

run.configuration: production single-arm retriever, 184-fact index, D-FIDELITY-7 and -8 wired
run.judge: MANDATORY (majority-of-N via OpenRouter). An explicit opt-out stamps the artifact SKIPPED and the headline is then not trustworthy alone.

baseline._re_derived_from: eval/results/gate_phase_d_paired_1476caa.json raw rows, not from any write-up
baseline._correction_to_my_own_stocktake: On 2026-10-08 I reported the baseline blend as 330/400 = 82.5%. That figure puts the 16 out_of_corpus rows in BOTH numerator and denominator (all 16 passed), so it is an in-corpus-plus-refusals number. R7 Gate 1 is an IN-CORPUS bar and the gate's own accuracy excludes OOC by design, so 81.8% is the like-for-like baseline. 82.5% must never be compared against this run's in-corpus figure.

expected._i_am_not_predicting_bar_a_clears_85: The fact-path bucket sat at 85.9% raw / 85.4% reliable at the baseline — ON R7's line, not clear of it. That bucket is where a first-time user's question lands, so it is the bucket to read first.

terms.basis: Exactly 2 rows of the 400 narrow their key (eval_355, eval_383); 22 of the 24 changed rows cannot move a score (19 are nssf.or.tz -> nssf.go.tz in gold prose). Measured by eval/controls/derive_gold_key_corrections_2026_10_09.py, read out of git.

12 of the 400 rows (3.0%) touch a fact corrected after the baseline; 5 of those 12 were FAILING at the baseline, so at most 5 can flip. Re-derived in eval/controls/pilot_stocktake_2026_10_08.py, not recalled.

terms.direction: A1 DOWN, A2 NOT AT ALL
terms.basis: D-FIDELITY-7 priced at 18 flags over 5,599 stored rows with 0 in gold; D-FIDELITY-8 at 1 flag over 13,632 rows, 0 in gold. Neither guard can produce a right answer.
terms._falsifier: If A2 RISES, that rise is NOT the guards' and must be attributed elsewhere. A guard converts a wrong answer into a non-answer; it never converts one into a right answer.

terms.bound: UNBOUNDED — AND IT IS THE LARGEST TERM
terms.basis: The drop is consolidation (221 -> 187 on 2026-08-26, three consolidated families) plus four stale renderings corrected out of production — not deletion. Consolidation is plausibly positive (the ask-aligned rewrites measured at rank 1), but NOTHING has measured its effect on these 400 questions, and nat_23 moving 45->46 from a single rewrite is the standing proof that index composition perturbs neighbours.

expected._if_the_result_lands_outside_a_plus_b: Term (d) is the first place to look, and that is NOT a reason to doubt the run.
expected._if_the_result_lands_below_the_projectio: That is a result to bring back, not a reason to reopen a decision. Standing instruction, 2026-08-08: decide against a real number, not a projected one.

row_to_watch.why: On 2026-10-06 it served a fabricated TZS 11,000,000 EFD threshold with the corrected index row at rank 1 for BOTH phrasings — so there was no retrieval headroom left and the guard layer is the only layer that can reach it.
row_to_watch._this_is_a_fail_that_is_a_win: It still scores as a gate miss, correctly, because the user did not get their answer. A1 moves, A2 does not, and the answer is still owed: 'EFD applies regardless of turnover' is an A2 job on the fact path, where a blanking guard can only ship silence.
row_to_watch._if_it_still_asserts_the_figure: The guard is not reaching the fact path in production, and that is the finding of the run.
row_to_watch._and_a_negated_mention_is_not_the_defect: The correct answer CONTAINS the figure, under a negation — index row 57 reads 'EFD haina kizingiti cha mauzo kwa mwaka ... Na SI TZS 11,000,000'. The verdict is polarity-aware for exactly this reason.

two_numbers_and_a_count_never_a_net.A1: WRONG-ANSWER RATE — in-corpus rows answered with a located, wrong value
two_numbers_and_a_count_never_a_net.A2: RIGHT-ANSWER RATE — in-corpus rows the user can act on
two_numbers_and_a_count_never_a_net.G: GUARD INTERVENTIONS — a fidelity guard replaced or blanked the body

how_the_headline_must_be_read.containment_rule: A falling A1 with a flat A2 is CONTAINMENT, not improvement. The summary prints that word when it happens.
how_the_headline_must_be_read.gate_2_is_not_in_this_run: R7 requires BOTH gates simultaneously. No part of this output is a Gate-2 result and none of it is pilot readiness on its own.

declared_not_exercisable_offline: production's live /health (recorded either way; 'COULD NOT ASK' is a different claim from 'asked and it matched')
